class.name: StyleBoxLayered
class.brief_description: A style box made of layers.
class.description: A [StyleBox] that draws a list of [StyleBoxLayer]s in order, so complex looks such as raised buttons with a depth, a rim, a highlight and a border can be built without code. The corners can be smooth, or stepped like pixel art. Two layered style boxes with the same number and modes of layers are interpolated layer by layer, see [member StyleBox.transition_duration].

method.name: get_corner_radius
method.description: Returns the corner radius of the given [enum Corner].

method.name: set_corner_radius
method.description: Sets the corner radius of the given [enum Corner].

members.member: If [code]true[/code], smooth corners and skewed edges are antialiased. Only used with [constant CORNER_STYLE_SMOOTH].
The size of the antialiased edges, like [member StyleBoxFlat.anti_aliasing_size]. Only used with [constant CORNER_STYLE_SMOOTH] when [member anti_aliasing] is [code]true[/code].
Moves the content of the control without changing its size, for example to move the text of a pressed button down.
Number of segments of each smooth corner. Only used with [constant CORNER_STYLE_SMOOTH].
The radius of the bottom-left corner.
The radius of the bottom-right corner.
The radius of the top-left corner.
The radius of the top-right corner.
The layers to draw, from the bottom to the top.
Size of the steps of pixel corners, skewed edges and soft edges. A corner radius equal to it cuts a single pixel. With [member pixel_snap], also the grid sizes are snapped to.
If [code]true[/code], the rectangle is rounded to whole pixels, and the margins, offsets, widths and corner radii of the layers to multiples of [member pixel_size].

Skews all layers around the center of the style box, like [member StyleBoxFlat.skew]: the horizontal part moves the rows sideways, the vertical part moves the columns up and down. With [constant CORNER_STYLE_PIXEL], the shape is drawn on a grid of [member pixel_size], so the skewed edges make stairs.

constants.constant: Stepped corners, like pixel art. Each step is [member pixel_size] large.
